source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Λογγίνος ο Ερημίτης»

attestations.note: The day's line calls him only ο Ερημίτης, the hermit; his own page gives the place that tells him apart, «Ο Όσιος Λογγίνος του Κορυάζχεμσκ». The translation of his relics into the church sixteen years after his repose is recorded there and is not a second commemoration on this page.
